# SuperLibrary

> The memory of the stack: it keeps what agents make and what work has been done, each labelled with how it turned out.

SuperLibrary stores artifacts (uploaded or agent-linked files and folders, versioned) and SuperPipeline work history. Every item carries one of seven outcomes: approved, completed, in-progress, superseded, rejected, failed or abandoned. People search and browse it in the web app and the suli command-line client; agents consult it before they work through an MCP server with three read-only tools (library_search, library_get, library_related). The source is MIT licensed.

## Docs

- [What SuperLibrary is](https://docs.superlibrary.dev/what-it-is/): a library of artifacts and work history, each labelled by outcome
- [Install](https://docs.superlibrary.dev/install/): install the suli client, sign in, run it locally
- [Concepts](https://docs.superlibrary.dev/concepts/): items, outcomes, sources, collections, retrieval and visibility
- [Docs llms.txt](https://docs.superlibrary.dev/llms.txt): the documentation as plain text for agents
